title: Coumarin–naphthalene conjugate for rapid optical detection of OCl− and Y3+ in a cascade manner: combined experimental and theoretical studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13111-13118
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00689A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
T. Shyam, N. Jahan, D. Das
An ESIPT-active coumarin–naphthalene conjugate (A3) ratiometrically recognizes OCl− and Y3+ in a cascade manner. The LODs for OCl− and Y3+ are 18.42 nM and 98.51 nM, respectively.
